questions.question: Why did the KPI snapshot ship before any filing parser?
options: The parsers depend on the snapshot's CSV
The KPI API keeps no history, so each day not saved is lost, while filings can be parsed at any time
GitHub Actions requires a scheduled job before other workflows can run
The snapshot was the easiest step to write
questions.explanation: Filings stay on EDGAR and can be parsed years later. The API returns only the current value, so the clock started with the first saved row.

questions.question: What does 'append-only, never force-push' protect on the data branch?
options: Rows that exist nowhere else, since the API cannot resend them
The order of the CSV columns
questions.explanation: A force-push can drop earlier commits. Each KPI row is the only record of that day's value, so the branch only ever grows.

questions.question: Which value does positive('mNav', v) accept?
questions.explanation: positive() rejects booleans (True is the integer 1 in Python), anything not an int or float, non-finite values and values at or below zero. Only the float 1.1971 passes.

questions.question: The snapshot job runs twice on 2026-09-26. What ends up on disk?
options: One CSV row and one JSON file
Two CSV rows and two JSON files
One CSV row and two JSON files
Two CSV rows and one JSON file, the second run's payload
questions.explanation: save() appends a CSV row on every run, but the raw file is named data/kpi/<date>.json, so the second run replaces it. The data branch shows this on 2026-09-25: two rows, one 2026-09-25.json.

questions.question: Why does snapshot.yml push the KPI row before running check.py?
options: check.py reads the new row from the data branch
If check.py hangs past the job timeout, GitHub cancels the job, and a cancelled job would skip both the commit and the alert
Pushing first makes check.py run faster
The data branch rejects commits made after check.py runs
questions.explanation: Build note #20: a timed-out job is cancelled, not failed. Committing first keeps the row whatever happens after, and the 5-minute step timeout lets the alert step still run.
